properties.name: Alto High-Speed Rail
properties.timeline: Canada's Alto high-speed rail initiative is in co-development for an electrified passenger rail corridor between Toronto and Québec City.
properties.description: A planned high-speed passenger rail corridor connecting Toronto, Peterborough, Ottawa, Montréal, Laval, Trois-Rivières, and Québec City.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Toronto–Québec City corridor; final alignment and station geometry are not yet fixed.
